summary: Minimal UDP socket wrappers for IPv4 datagrams.

types.name: struct endpoint
types.description: A struct that stores an IPv4 socket address and its native length.

types.name: struct datagram
types.description: A struct that describes one received UDP datagram.

types.name: struct udp_socket
types.description: A struct that owns a UDP socket descriptor.

functions.name: ipv4
functions.signature: std::opt<endpoint> endpoint::ipv4(const char* address, u16 port)
functions.description: Builds an IPv4 endpoint from a dotted address and port.
functions.returnDescription: Some endpoint when the address is valid.

functions.name: bind
functions.description: Binds a UDP socket to an endpoint.
functions.returnDescription: Some void on success or none on failure.

functions.name: send_to
functions.signature: std::opt<u64> udp_socket::send_to(udp_socket& this, const std::span<const u8> buffer, endpoint& remote)
functions.description: Sends a byte span to a remote UDP endpoint.
functions.returnDescription: Some number of bytes sent or none on failure.

functions.name: recv_from
functions.signature: std::opt<datagram> udp_socket::recv_from(udp_socket& this, void* buffer, u64 capacity)
functions.description: Receives one UDP datagram into a caller-provided buffer.
functions.returnDescription: Some datagram on success or none on failure.
